topic: Red flags in cloud mining offers
title: 3 Red Flags in Cloud Mining Contracts
hook: Three red flags to spot in any mining offer.

scenes.narration: The SEC's investor alert warns about promised high returns with little risk.
Pressure to act fast is another warning sign.
Being asked to pay extra costs before you can withdraw profits is a third.

cta: Seen any of these? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Promised returns, pressure and extra payments are classic warning signs.
